card.name: US justice and government news text
card.fires_on: Words inside US government, law and crime news text, often partway through an abbreviation like U.S. or a title like Attorney General, or just before a name such as O.J. Simpson.

modes.label: Abbreviations and titles
modes.description: Partway through U.S. or a title such as Attorney that leads into a government body or official.
modes.example: Kirschner said he would like a more definitive answer from U<<.S>>. regulators about whether BPA is safe

modes.label: Before a famous name
modes.description: The word or letter just before a well-known name or group in crime and politics news.

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated.
card.plain: It lights up in US news about courts, crime and government, especially partway through U.S. or an official's title.
